title: CI: Add concurrency to release workflow to avoid semantic-release upstream changed failures
description:
We saw python-semantic-release fail with:
- "Upstream branch 'origin/main' has changed!" when a newer commit was pushed while the release job was running.

Fix:
- Add GitHub Actions concurrency for the Release workflow (grouped by branch/event) with cancel-in-progress so older runs are cancelled when a new push lands.

Acceptance:
- Pushing multiple commits quickly to main does not produce failing semantic-release jobs due to upstream moving.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Added workflow-level concurrency (cancel-in-progress) to Release workflow
